```{r setup}
# Dependencies
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
```

```{r setup}

# Variables to change

# Data file: update this path to match your batch file
data_file <- "auto_report_input_data.rds"

# Path to pdf files
pdf_path <- "Articles All Records/files"

# Articles to include in the batch (first article number, last article number).
# Only used when this script is rendered manually — when driven by
# generate_coder_batch.R, params$batch_ids overrides this with the exact
# (possibly non-contiguous) ID list for that coder's batch.
batch_articles <- c(1, 100)

```

```{r}
include_batch <- if (!is.null(params$batch_ids)) {
  params$batch_ids
} else {
  # IDs are generated in script 2 as P001, P002, ... — this fills in the
  # numbers and expands them to the matching zero-padded ID range automatically.
  sprintf("P%03d", batch_articles[1]:batch_articles[2])
}

# Keywords in protocol order. Gapped-pair labels from Pilot_pipeline.qmd's
# key_phrases_gapped (e.g. "available request") are NOT listed here — the report
# loop below appends whatever keyword labels actually show up in each article's
# keyword_data, so gapped pairs display automatically without needing to be
# kept in sync with this list.
code_keywords <- c("code", "script", "osf", "git", "figshare", "supplement",
                   "replicate", "reproduce", "zenodo", "appendix", "syntax",
                   "upon request", "restricted access", "upon reasonable request")

# PDF lookup: scan PilotItems/files/ for PDFs and map doi_no_slash -> relative path
pdf_files <- list.files(pdf_path, pattern = "\\.pdf$",
                        recursive = TRUE, full.names = FALSE)
pdf_lookup <- setNames(
  file.path(pdf_path, pdf_files),
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(pdf_files))
)

if (file.exists(data_file)) {
  articles <- readRDS(data_file)
} else {
  stop(paste("Data file not found:", data_file))
}

# Restrict to the requested batch of article IDs
articles <- articles %>% filter(ID %in% include_batch)

if (nrow(articles) == 0) {
  stop("No articles found for IDs ", include_batch[1], " to ",
       include_batch[length(include_batch)], " — check batch_articles and the ID range in ", data_file)
}

message("Generating report for ", nrow(articles), " of ", length(include_batch),
        " requested articles (", include_batch[1], " to ",
        include_batch[length(include_batch)], ")")

# Remove invisible Unicode characters that PDF extraction inserts into URLs
# (zero-width space, zero-width non-joiner/joiner, soft hyphen, BOM)
clean_url <- function(url) {
  str_remove_all(url, "[​‌‍­﻿]")
}

# Extract all unique URLs from a character vector of text snippets
extract_urls <- function(texts) {
  texts <- texts[!is.na(texts)]
  matches <- str_extract_all(texts, "https?://[^\\s<>\"'\\)\\]]+")
  urls <- unlist(matches)
  urls <- str_remove(urls, "[.,;:!?]+$")   # strip trailing punctuation
  urls <- sapply(urls, clean_url, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  unique(urls[nzchar(urls)])
}

# Wrap URLs in text with clickable <a> tags (cleans href, keeps display text clean too)
linkify <- function(text) {
  if (is.na(text) || nchar(text) == 0) return(text)
  str_replace_all(text,
    "(https?://[^\\s<>\"'\\)\\]]+)",
    function(url) {
      clean <- clean_url(url)
      sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', clean, clean)
    })
}

# Bold keywords in already-linkified text, skipping content inside <a> tags
bold_keywords <- function(text, keywords) {
  for (kw in keywords) {
    text <- str_replace_all(text,
      regex(paste0("(<a\\s[^>]*>.*?</a>)|(\\b", kw, "\\w*)"), ignore_case = TRUE),
      function(m) ifelse(startsWith(m, "<a "), m, paste0("<strong>", m, "</strong>")))
  }
  text
}

# Find context windows around every occurrence of a URL in the full text.
# Returns a character vector of unique context strings (one per occurrence).
# Matches by stripping whitespace (handles GROBID-broken URLs in body text).
get_url_contexts <- function(full_text, url, n_before = 1, n_after = 1) {
  if (is.na(full_text) || nchar(full_text) == 0) return(character(0))
  sentences <- unlist(strsplit(full_text, "(?<=[.!?])\\s+", perl = TRUE))

  url_core <- url %>%
    str_remove("^https?://") %>%
    str_remove_all("\\s") %>%
    substr(1, 30) %>%
    str_replace_all("([.?+*()\\[\\]{}|^$\\\\])", "\\\\\\1")

  idx <- which(str_detect(str_remove_all(sentences, "\\s"),
                           regex(url_core, ignore_case = TRUE)))
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(character(0))

  contexts <- sapply(idx, function(i) {
    paste(sentences[max(1, i - n_before):min(length(sentences), i + n_after)],
          collapse = " ")
  })
  unique(contexts)
}
```

```{r report, results='asis'}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(articles))) {
  article    <- articles[i, ]
  keyword_df <- article$keyword_data[[1]]

  context_texts <- if (!is.null(keyword_df) && nrow(keyword_df) > 0)
    keyword_df$context else character(0)

  all_urls <- if ("urls" %in% names(article) && length(article$urls[[1]]) > 0) {
    article$urls[[1]]
  } else {
    extract_urls(c(article$abstract, context_texts))
  }

  # ── Article header ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s. %s\n\n", article$ID, article$title))

  # ── Metadata ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat(sprintf('**DOI:** %s  \n', article$DOI))
  cat(sprintf('**Link:** <a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>  \n',
              article$`DOI Link`, article$`DOI Link`))
  # Existence is always checked against the real corpus (pdf_path); the href
  # written into the report points there too UNLESS pdf_link_dir is set (by
  # generate_coder_batch.R), in which case it points at a flat pdfs/<doi>.pdf
  # path instead, matching where that script copies the batch's PDFs to.
  pdf_src <- pdf_lookup[article$doi_no_slash]
  if (!is.na(pdf_src)) {
    pdf_href <- if (!is.null(params$pdf_link_dir)) {
      file.path(params$pdf_link_dir, paste0(article$doi_no_slash, ".pdf"))
    } else {
      pdf_src
    }
    cat(sprintf('**PDF:** <a href="%s" target="_blank">Open PDF</a>\n\n', pdf_href))
  } else {
    cat("\n")
  }

  # ── Abstract (collapsed) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  bold_abstract <- linkify(article$abstract)
  cat('<details style="margin-bottom:1em;"><summary><strong>Abstract</strong></summary>\n')
  cat('<div style="padding:0.5em 0;">', bold_abstract, "</div></details>\n\n")

  # ── Links found in paper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (length(all_urls) > 0) {
    cat("<h4>Links Found in Paper</h4>\n")
    all_urls <- all_urls[order(str_detect(all_urls, regex("doi", ignore_case = TRUE)))]
    # Pre-extracted contexts from XML (keyed by clean target URL)
    xml_url_data <- if ("url_data" %in% names(article) && !is.null(article$url_data[[1]]))
      article$url_data[[1]] else tibble(url = character(0), context = character(0))
    for (url in all_urls) {
      url_link <- sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', url, url)
      # Use XML-extracted context first; fall back to full-text search
      xml_ctx  <- xml_url_data$context[xml_url_data$url == url]
      contexts <- if (length(xml_ctx) > 0 && any(nzchar(xml_ctx))) {
        unique(xml_ctx[nzchar(xml_ctx)])
      } else {
        get_url_contexts(article$full_text, url)
      }
      cat(sprintf('<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0.2em;"><strong style="color:black;">Link:</strong> <span style="font-size:1.15em;">%s</span></p>\n', url_link))
      if (length(contexts) > 0) {
        cat('<p style="margin-bottom:0.2em;color:black;">Contexts:</p>\n')
        for (ctx in contexts) {
          ctx_hl <- linkify(ctx)
          cat(sprintf('<blockquote style="margin-top:0.2em;">%s</blockquote>\n\n', ctx_hl))
        }
      }
    }
    cat("\n")
  }

  # ── Keyword matches (each keyword collapsed) ─────────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(keyword_df) && nrow(keyword_df) > 0) {
    cat("<h4>Keyword Matches</h4>\n")
    # Protocol keywords first (in order), then any other labels found in the
    # data (e.g. gapped-pair matches like "available request") appended after.
    display_keywords <- unique(c(code_keywords, keyword_df$keyword))
    for (kw in display_keywords) {
      contexts <- keyword_df$context[keyword_df$keyword == kw]
      if (length(contexts) == 0) next
      cat(sprintf(
        '<details style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">\n<summary><strong style="font-size:1.15em;">%s</strong></summary>\n',
        kw))
      for (ctx in contexts) {
        # Bold the individual words of a gapped-pair label too (e.g. "available"
        # and "request"), since they rarely appear as one contiguous phrase.
        bold_words <- unique(c(code_keywords, strsplit(kw, "\\s+")[[1]]))
        ctx_hl <- bold_keywords(linkify(ctx), bold_words)
        cat(sprintf('<blockquote>%s</blockquote>\n', ctx_hl))
      }
      cat('</details>\n\n')
    }
  } else {
    cat("*No keyword matches found.*\n\n")
  }

  cat("\n---\n")
}
```
